title: SEBI amendments assigning responsibility for the use of AI and ML tools (Intermediaries and SECC Regulations, 2025)
summary: SEBI amended the SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008 and the Securities Contracts (Regulation) (Stock Exchanges and Clearing Corporations) Regulations, 2018 through notifications dated 6 February 2025, after a consultation paper of 13 November 2024. Any SEBI-regulated person that uses AI or machine-learning tools, whether built in-house or bought from vendors and whatever the scale of use, is solely responsible for the privacy, security and integrity of investor data, for the output of those tools, and for compliance with applicable laws. The change builds on 2019 SEBI circulars that require stock brokers, depository participants, market infrastructure institutions and mutual funds to report the AI/ML systems they use.
key_obligations: Regulated entity is solely responsible for outputs of AI/ML tools it uses
Protect privacy, security and integrity of investor and stakeholder data
Ensure AI/ML use complies with applicable laws
Applies to in-house and third-party tools regardless of scale
